find: if (back - DASH_LEN / 2 < corner && back + DASH_LEN / 2 > corner) {
killedBy: shell bounce-trail after a bounce (issue #774) moves a dash that would straddle the corner wholly onto one leg
why: A dash whose span covers the corner would be drawn half on each side of the fold, its far half inside the wall. Moving it wholly onto the leg that holds its centre keeps every dash in the open.
